body:
## Result and scope

Record **claimed_solved, 5/5** for the primary Conjecture 2 on p.1124 of Oberwolfach Report 21/2009. Its bound is epsilon(S,L;x) >= 1/(2+|K_S^2|^(1/4)) for smooth minimal complex projective surfaces, ample integral L, and arbitrary x. The catalogue misplaced the additive 2 under the fourth root; this construction addresses the primary conjecture itself.

The degree-seven example has ample canonical bundle with K_S^2=144, an ample L with L^2=6, and an integral curve of L-degree 1 and multiplicity 6. Hence epsilon <=1/6 <1/(2+144^(1/4)). The proof supplies a family for every d>=7. No exact epsilon, very-general-point, or fixed-surface vanishing claim is made.

## Review and reproducibility

- Preserve the unchanged frozen author proof, five-route history, source notes, scripts and original manifest.
- Preserve the full separate source-first independent AI audit. It found no fatal mathematical error or missing construction step.
- Add a separate release note clarifying that Bauer's d=m+1 citation is asymptotic; the proof's own polynomial/parameter-space argument establishes d=7. It also records the explanatory identity N=(d-3)H+F without editing either frozen packet.
- Both author programs and the independent program replay byte-exactly in the final layout and after reading every file back from GitHub. The independent program reports 60,731 assertions, including integrity/replay checks; these counts do not prove geometric existence.
- Strict manifest checks and eight negative integrity controls pass. Run python3 verify_release.py and python3 test_integrity.py in unsolved_math_prioritization/attempts/30001232/ (Python 3; SymPy 1.14.0).
- The queue changes only this row's Status, Turns, and previously blank Findings. All other queue bytes are preserved, including existing headers and links.

This work is heavily AI-assisted and unrefereed. Historical novelty and first priority are unverified; the audit is not external peer review. No source PDF, extraction, image, corpus, or private coordination file is included. No merge, release, Zenodo deposit, DOI, or outreach is part of this PR.
title: 30001232: audited minimal-surface Seshadri counterexample candidate
